title: Foundry Workspace (foundry.workspace.json)
description: The master multi-repo manifest, placed at the ROOT of a platform's ops repo (or any aggregator directory). Names the member repos — resolved as sibling clones of the ops repo (or children of an aggregator directory) — and the named run profiles used by `foundry run dev --profile <name>` / `foundry run dev:<name>`. Discovery: FOUNDRY_WORKSPACE (a file, or a directory holding one) wins; otherwise the CLI walks up from the current directory checking each directory AND its immediate children, so running inside any sibling clone still finds it.

$schema.description: Editor hint. Point at the published schema for validation/autocomplete.

repos.description: Member repository DIRECTORY names (not URLs), each carrying its own .foundry/foundry.json (or root foundry.json). A repo not cloned locally is skipped with a notice — a partially-checked-out workspace still runs.

profiles.description: Named run profiles: profile name -> the manifest SERVICE names (keys under `services` in the member manifests, not repo names) it starts. `foundry run dev:core` boots the `core` profile's services from every member repo in one session; each service keeps its own repo's env files, tunnels, and credentials. A profile naming an unknown service warns and continues.
